description: Whether one project or AI process is running right now, with its PID. Lighter than list_projects when you already have the id, for example to confirm that start_project or stop_project took effect (both can return before the change has landed). 'No status found' means DevGlow has no entry with that id. For past runs, use get_run_history.

id.description: Project or AI process ID (from list_projects)

name: get_status
title: Get project status
